description: Selection 'D' on row 2: the WHEN 'D' arm at :200-209, the sibling of case13. The scan skips row 1 because SEL0001I is blank and stops at row 2, so CDEMO-CU00-USR-SELECTED becomes USRID02I. 'COUSR03C' is moved into CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM and the XCTL at :206-209 transfers. The two arms differ only in the program they name, and asserting both is what proves the EVALUATE at :189-215 is ordered rather than collapsed (gate G30). Two orderings are pinned at once. The EVALUATE TRUE at :151-185 is a first-match scan over SEL0001I through SEL0010I, so a blank row 1 does not end it and a ticked row 2 does; had it been collapsed into a search for any ticked cell, this case would still pass while case15 - two cells ticked, the lower winning - would not. Then the guard at :187-188 admits the second EVALUATE only because CDEMO-CU00-USR-SEL-FLG and CDEMO-CU00-USR-SELECTED are both non-blank, which is what the paired MOVEs at :156-157 just made true. CDEMO-FROM-TRANID and CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM carry WS-TRANID and WS-PGMNAME from :203-204, whose VALUE clauses at :36-37 are 'CU00' and 'COUSR00C', and :205 zeroes CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT so the program being entered sees a first entry rather than the re-entry this one arrived on. What the case pins by ABSENCE matters as much. The XCTL at :206-209 leaves PROCESS-ENTER-KEY before :218, so USRIDINI is never moved into SEC-USR-ID; before :227, so CDEMO-CU00-PAGE-NUM is never zeroed and passes through as it arrived; and before :228, so PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD never runs. USRSEC is therefore never browsed - no STARTBR, no READNEXT, no READPREV, no ENDBR (gate G47) - no page arithmetic fires at :304, :309-310, :320-321, :358 or :367 (gate G28, negatively), and no map is sent, which is why sends is empty rather than carrying a screen image. The cursor is USRIDINL from the unconditional MOVE -1 at :108, not from anything this arm did. The ten seeded records are pinned unchanged, and expectedDatasets pins the row count as well as the rows: ten row expectations detect a deleted record by the index shift it causes but are blind to an appended one, and on the arm that routes to the DELETE screen that is precisely the wrong blind spot. Note that COUSR00C LISTS users - :5 reads 'List all users from USRSEC file' and README.md records CU00 as List Users - while the class is named UserMenuController because the mandated name is honoured verbatim and the behaviour is taken from the source, the divergence documented rather than corrected (rule R1, practice B4, AAP 0.8.4). The dead WS-USER-DATA array at :56-64 stays unmodelled and the plaintext SEC-USR-PWD span is carried as the copybook declares it, neither hashed nor tidied (practices B5, B6). PROVENANCE: statically derived by structured reading of app/cbl/COUSR00C.cbl:98-144 and :149-232 against the byte layout of app/cpy/CSUSR01Y.cpy, the xxxI PICTURE clauses of app/cpy-bms/COUSR00.CPY, the 34-byte extension at :67-75 over app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy, and the in-stream records of app/jcl/DUSRSECJ.jcl:35-44 at the LRECL=80 its :48 declares. It was never captured from a live COBOL run - AAP 0.7.6 proves execution impossible here on eight verified blockers - so every value above traces to a source line rather than to an observation, which is the escalated provenance deviation recorded as risk R-A (practice B12).
